title: The Field of Flowers
text: White flowers to the horizon, under a sky that is for once only a sky. No birds sing. No wind moves the petals. The air is sweet and the ground is soft, and there is nothing wrong here at all, which is the most wrong thing you have seen in days.

options.label: Lie down among the flowers and rest. Surely you have earned a moment of peace.

outcomes.text: You sleep in the flowers and wake whole and clear-headed. There was no catch. That is the hardest thing to believe.

options.label: Don't trust it. Keep walking with your eyes down, and do not breathe too deeply.

outcomes.text: You walk through quickly, eyes down. Afterwards, some of you wish you had stayed, and dream of the white petals for weeks.
